subject: E-6155: token rejected on Android
body:
Hello support team. We run Tallyboard 1.9.5 on Android 15
(Pixel 8). Whenever I log in since last week, the app shows
"E-6155: authentication token rejected".

It only happens on the office network; on my phone's hotspot
it works. IT installed a new web proxy for all staff this
month.

Before writing in I tried rebooting the router; same error
afterwards.

Regards, Mei Lin, Meridian Schools
